correctness.rationale: PASS: Checked the continuous configuration-space definition, distinction between unordered and ordered pairs, unit-edge graph realization and ordinary topological versus Borel quotient. The piecewise explicit same-edge homotopy separates x<y to endpoints and incident-edge homotopy scales distances by 1-t+t/max(s,u); limits at common vertices/remote endpoints match, preserve disjoint-carrier configurations pointwise, avoid collisions and commute with vertex permutations. Thus X_m equivariantly strongly deformation retracts to the cubical D_m; barycentric flag vertices have distinct cell dimensions so no inversions. The stabilizer-orbit proof treats each 0<1, 0<2, 1<2, 0<1<2 flag and all m, with split exceptions m=3,4,5 and unsplit m>=6. Inspected finite checker construction of orbit cells/cellular boundaries and explicit elementary quotient collapses for m=2..6. For A4, two triangles attach along an edge but leave two parallel edges after collapses, so pi1=Z; A5 collapses to tree, S_m and larger A_m quotients to contractible triangles. Finite cases do not substitute for the stabilizer proof at all m.
